Each analysis is run on the same public file twice: by **`chromosomix`**, the command-line form of
the app's Analysis panel (the same code), and by the **reference package** it reproduces, called as
its authors intend. The two outputs are matched bin by bin or call by call. Every command is printed
as it ran, from `notebooks/work/validation/`, and its CPU time is measured in the last section.

| § | Analysis | Data | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Diamond insulation | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.insulation` |
| 2 | Directionality index | mouse Hi-C, 50 kb | `domaincaller` |
| 3 | Compartments | mouse Hi-C, 100 kb | `cooltools.eigs_cis` |
| 4 | P(s) | yeast Micro-C, 800 bp; mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.expected_cis` |
| 5 | Peak calling | mouse ATAC-seq, two replicates, chr19 | yapc 0.1 with IDR 2.0.3 |
| 6 | Loops | yeast Micro-C, 800 bp | chromosight 1.6.3 |
| 7 | Reproducibility | chicken Hi-C, three maps, 100 kb | hicrep 0.2.6 |
| 8 | 3D model | yeast Micro-C, 12.8 kb | pastis (GitHub `6888ac2`) |

**To render.** `npm run build:cli` at the repository root builds this checkout's `chromosomix`.
yapc needs an environment of its own (numpy < 1.24; the recipe is in the yapc section of
`scripts/make_analysis_golden.py`); the other references share one:

```bash
python -m venv refs && . refs/bin/activate
pip install jupyter matplotlib cooler cooltools bioframe pyfaidx pyBigWig 'pandas<3' \
    chromosight==1.6.3 hicrep==0.2.6 domaincaller==0.1.0 \
    'git+https://github.com/hiclib/pastis@6888ac25ded72ce3e559987b8a31b3f8ed2935ed'
QUARTO_PYTHON=refs/bin/python YAPC_PYTHON=yapc-env/bin/python quarto render notebooks/validation.qmd
```

The data (6 GB) are fetched once into `notebooks/work/validation/data/`. Outputs and timings are kept
beside them, so a second render reads rather than recomputes (`REDO`, `REDO_BENCHMARK`).

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os

#: Run a step again even where its outputs are already on disk.
REDO = False
#: Timed runs of each command, and whether to time them again.
RUNS = 5
REDO_BENCHMARK = False
#: Processes for the reference packages that take them.
THREADS = 4
#: yapc 0.1's interpreter, relative to the repository or absolute.
YAPC_PYTHON = os.environ.get('YAPC_PYTHON', 'yapc-env/bin/python')

HERE = Path.cwd().resolve()
REPO = HERE.parent if HERE.name == 'notebooks' else HERE
CLI = REPO / 'dist-cli' / 'chromosomix.mjs'
WORK = REPO / 'notebooks' / 'work' / 'validation'
DATA = WORK / 'data'
SCRIPTS = REPO / 'notebooks' / 'scripts'
YAPC_PYTHON = Path(YAPC_PYTHON) if Path(YAPC_PYTHON).is_absolute() else REPO / YAPC_PYTHON
```

```{python}
import html
import json
import platform
import re
import resource
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import warnings
from importlib.metadata import version

import cooler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyBigWig
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from scipy import stats

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
if not CLI.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'{CLI} is not there: run `npm run build:cli` at the repository root.')
DATA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PYTHON = sys.executable
CHROMOSIGHT = shutil.which('chromosight') or str(Path(PYTHON).parent / 'chromosight')
YAPC_ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=f'{YAPC_PYTHON.parent}{os.pathsep}{os.environ["PATH"]}')


def fetch(url, name=None):
    """A public file, fetched once into work/validation/data."""
    path = DATA / (name or urllib.parse.unquote(url.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]))
    if not path.exists():
        print('fetching', url)
        part = path.with_name(path.name + '.part')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response, open(part, 'wb') as out:
            shutil.copyfileobj(response, out, 1 << 22)
        part.rename(path)
    return path


def rel(path):
    """A path as the commands give it: a file of this repository relative to work/validation/, where
    they run; any other as it is."""
    path = Path(path)
    return os.path.relpath(path, WORK) if path.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(path)


def arg(value):
    return rel(value) if isinstance(value, Path) else str(value)


def typed(argv):
    """A command as a reader would type it: each tool by its installed name."""
    names = {PYTHON: 'python', str(YAPC_PYTHON): 'yapc-env/bin/python', CHROMOSIGHT: 'chromosight'}
    if argv[:2] == ['node', str(CLI)]:
        argv = ['chromosomix', *argv[2:]]
    return shlex.join([names.get(a, a) for a in argv])


#: Every chromosomix command and every reference command, by name: for the summary and the timing.
APP, REFS, NOTES = {}, {}, {}
#: Where a reference writes, in its command.
OUT = '<out>'


def mr(task, *args, out, name, analysis, label='', bench=True):
    """One chromosomix command into `out`, skipped when `out` already holds its outputs."""
    out = Path(out)
    argv = ['node', str(CLI), task, *[arg(a) for a in args]]
    full = argv + ['--out', rel(out)]
    APP[name] = dict(analysis=analysis, tool='chromosomix', label=label, argv=argv, bench=bench,
                     shown=typed(full))
    print('$', typed(full))
    if not (out / '.command').exists() or REDO:
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        start = time.time()
        run = subprocess.run(full, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORK)
        if run.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(run.stderr[-4000:])
        notes = [line.strip()[len('note: '):] for line in re.split(r'[\r\n]', run.stderr)
                 if line.strip().startswith('note:')]
        (out / '.notes').write_text('\n'.join(notes))
        (out / '.command').write_text(f'{typed(full)}\n# {time.time() - start:.1f} s\n')
    NOTES[name] = (out / '.notes').read_text().splitlines()
    return out


def script(name):
    """A reference's script, in notebooks/scripts/: run, printed and timed."""
    path = SCRIPTS / f'{name}.py'
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{path} is not there.')
    return path


def reference(name, analysis, tool, argv, out, made=None, env=None, label='', bench=True):
    """A reference command, run once for the comparison (skipped when its output is on disk).

    `argv` holds OUT where the command writes, so the timing can send it elsewhere."""
    argv = [a if a == OUT else arg(a) for a in argv]
    out = Path(out)
    real = [rel(out) if a == OUT else a for a in argv]
    REFS[name] = dict(analysis=analysis, tool=tool, label=label, argv=argv, out=out, env=env, bench=bench,
                      shown=typed(real), scripts=[a for a in argv if a.endswith('.py')])
    print('$', typed(real))
    if REDO or not Path(made or out).exists():
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        run = subprocess.run(real, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORK, env=env)
        if run.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(run.stderr[-4000:])
    return out


def table(path):
    """A table chromosomix wrote: its '#' lines are provenance, not data."""
    return pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t', comment='#')


def one(folder, pattern):
    """The one file of `folder` matching `pattern`."""
    hits = sorted(Path(folder).glob(pattern))
    if len(hits) != 1:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{len(hits)} files match {pattern} in {folder}')
    return hits[0]


def cached(path, compute):
    """A result of this notebook's own, computed once and kept: a table as TSV, an array as NPY."""
    path = Path(path)
    if path.exists() and not REDO:
        return pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t') if path.suffix == '.tsv' else np.load(path)
    value = compute()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.suffix == '.tsv':
        value.to_csv(path, sep='\t', index=False)
    else:
        np.save(path, value)
    return value


def show(frame, precision=4, **formats):
    """A table without row numbers: the columns named in `formats` their way, the others to `precision`."""
    return frame.style.hide(axis='index').format(formats or None, precision=precision)


def measures(values):
    """Named numbers as a two-column table."""
    return pd.DataFrame(list(values.items()), columns=['measure', 'value']).style.hide(axis='index')


def pearson(a, b):
    ok = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
    return stats.pearsonr(a[ok], b[ok])[0]


# Blue is chromosomix, orange the reference.
APP_COLOUR, REF = '#2a78d6', '#eb6834'
INK, INK2, GRID, SURFACE, MISSING = '#0b0b0b', '#52514e', '#e7e6e2', '#fcfcfb', '#efeeea'
DENSITY = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    'density', ['#cde2fb', '#86b6ef', '#3987e5', '#1c5cab', '#0d366b'])
plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.facecolor': SURFACE, 'axes.facecolor': SURFACE, 'savefig.facecolor': SURFACE,
    'axes.edgecolor': INK2, 'axes.labelcolor': INK, 'xtick.color': INK2, 'ytick.color': INK2,
    'text.color': INK, 'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.grid': True, 'grid.color': GRID, 'grid.linewidth': 0.6, 'axes.axisbelow': True,
    'lines.linewidth': 2, 'font.size': 9, 'axes.titlesize': 10, 'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.titlelocation': 'left', 'legend.frameon': False, 'figure.dpi': 110,
})


def identity(ax, lo, hi):
    ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], color=INK2, lw=1, ls=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=3)


def agreement(ax, x, y, xlabel, ylabel, title, scale='linear'):
    """Every pair of values as a density, against the identity line."""
    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    if scale == 'log':
        ok &= (x > 0) & (y > 0)
    x, y = x[ok], y[ok]
    ax.hexbin(x, y, gridsize=70, cmap=DENSITY, mincnt=1, bins='log', linewidths=0,
              xscale=scale, yscale=scale)
    identity(ax, min(x.min(), y.min()), max(x.max(), y.max()))
    ax.set(xlabel=xlabel, ylabel=ylabel, title=title)
    ax.text(0.03, 0.97, f'{ok.sum():,} values\nPearson r = {stats.pearsonr(x, y)[0]:.4f}',
            transform=ax.transAxes, va='top', fontsize=8, color=INK2)


TEXT = {}
SUMMARY = []


def commands(lines):
    return '<pre>' + html.escape('\n'.join(lines)) + '</pre>'


def record(task, data, reference_, agreement_, verdict, apps, refs):
    """One row of the summary, with the commands as they ran."""
    SUMMARY.append({'Analysis': task, 'Data': data,
                    'chromosomix command': commands([f'$ {APP[name]["shown"]}' for name in apps]),
                    'Reference': reference_,
                    'Reference command': commands([f'$ {REFS[name]["shown"]}' for name in refs]),
                    'Agreement': agreement_, 'Verdict': verdict})
```

## Data and versions

Every file is public, read by its accession and fetched from the URL listed. 4DN files come from the
4DN Data Portal's open-data bucket on AWS; the mm10 sequence, used only to phase compartments by GC
content, is UCSC's as distributed by Illumina iGenomes.

```{python}
def commit():
    run = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=REPO)
    return run.stdout.strip() or 'unknown'


def yapc_versions():
    probe = 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("yapc"), m.version("idr"), m.version("numpy"))'
    try:
        run = subprocess.run([str(YAPC_PYTHON), '-c', probe], capture_output=True, text=True)
        return run.stdout.split() if run.returncode == 0 else ['?'] * 3
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return ['not found'] * 3


APP_VERSION = f"{json.loads((REPO / 'package.json').read_text())['version']} at {commit()}"
YAPC, IDR, YAPC_NUMPY = yapc_versions()
VERSIONS = {name: version(name) for name in (
    'cooler', 'cooltools', 'bioframe', 'chromosight', 'hicrep', 'domaincaller', 'pastis', 'numpy', 'scipy',
    'pandas')}
show(pd.DataFrame([{'package': 'chromosomix', 'version': APP_VERSION},
                   *[{'package': k, 'version': v} for k, v in VERSIONS.items()],
                   {'package': 'yapc (own environment)', 'version': f'{YAPC}, with idr {IDR} and numpy {YAPC_NUMPY}'}]))
```

## 1 · Diamond insulation

cooltools' definition: per bin, the mean of the valid cells of the `window × window` square on its
diagonal pixel, the `ignoreDiags` nearest diagonals left out, over the chromosome's median, in log2;
boundaries at the minima whose prominence reaches the threshold.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| window | `--window 10` (100 kb) | `window_bp=[100_000]` |
| diagonals left out | `--ignoreDiags 2` (default) | `ignore_diags=2` |
| least valid share of a diamond | `--minValid 0.5` (default) | `min_frac_valid_pixels=0.5` |
| boundary threshold | `--prominence 0.2` (default) | `threshold=0.2` |

```{python}
INS = WORK / 'insulation'
MOUSE_10K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/10000'
mr('insulation', MOUSE_10K, '--window', 10, out=INS / 'app', name='insulation', analysis='Diamond insulation')
reference('cooltools-insulation', 'Diamond insulation', 'cooltools',
          [PYTHON, script('cooltools_insulation'), MOUSE_10K, OUT, THREADS], out=INS / 'cooltools.tsv')

clr10 = cooler.Cooler(f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/10000')
bins10 = clr10.bins()[:]
ref_ins = pd.read_csv(INS / 'cooltools.tsv', sep='\t')
app_ins = table(one(INS / 'app', '*.insulation-w10.tsv'))
assert (app_ins['bin'].to_numpy() == np.arange(len(bins10))).all()
a_ins = app_ins['value'].to_numpy(float)
b_ins = ref_ins['log2_insulation_score_100000'].to_numpy(float)
both = np.isfinite(a_ins) & np.isfinite(b_ins)
ins_diff = np.abs(a_ins[both] - b_ins[both])

app_b = table(one(INS / 'app', '*.insulation-boundaries.tsv'))
ref_b = ref_ins.loc[ref_ins['is_boundary_100000'].astype(bool), ['chrom', 'start', 'boundary_strength_100000']]
calls = app_b[['chrom', 'start', 'score']].merge(ref_b, on=['chrom', 'start'], how='outer', indicator=True)
same_calls = calls[calls['_merge'] == 'both']
strength_diff = np.abs(same_calls['score'] - same_calls['boundary_strength_100000'])
measures({
    'bins both score': f'{both.sum():,}',
    'bins only one scores': f'{int((np.isfinite(a_ins) != np.isfinite(b_ins)).sum()):,}',
    'score, max |difference|': f'{ins_diff.max():.1e}',
    'boundaries, chromosomix / cooltools': f'{len(app_b):,} / {len(ref_b):,}',
    'boundaries at the same bin': f'{len(same_calls):,}',
    'boundary strength, max |difference|': f'{strength_diff.max():.1e}',
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-insulation
#| fig-cap: "Diamond insulation, 100 kb window. a, every bin; b, every boundary both call; c, chr11, 30–40 Mb (dropped bins shaded)."
TEXT['ins_n'] = f'{both.sum():,}'
TEXT['ins_max'] = f'{ins_diff.max():.1e}'
TEXT['ins_calls'] = f'{len(same_calls):,}'
TEXT['ins_only'] = f"{int((calls['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}"
TEXT['ins_strength'] = f'{strength_diff.max():.1e}'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 7.2), layout='constrained')
grid = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1])
agreement(fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 0]), b_ins[both], a_ins[both], 'cooltools (log2)', 'chromosomix (log2)',
          'a  every bin')
ax = fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 1])
ax.scatter(same_calls['boundary_strength_100000'], same_calls['score'], s=4, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.35, lw=0,
           rasterized=True)
identity(ax, 0, same_calls['boundary_strength_100000'].max())
ax.set(xlabel='cooltools boundary strength', ylabel='chromosomix prominence', title='b  every boundary')
ax = fig.add_subplot(grid[1, :])
lo, _ = clr10.extent('chr11')
stretch = slice(lo + 3_000, lo + 4_000)
x = bins10['start'].to_numpy()[stretch] / 1e6
for pos in x[~np.isfinite(bins10['weight'].to_numpy(float)[stretch])]:
    ax.axvspan(pos, pos + 0.01, color=MISSING, lw=0, zorder=0)
ax.plot(x, b_ins[stretch], color=REF, lw=3, label='cooltools')
ax.plot(x, a_ins[stretch], color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix')
ax.set(xlabel='chr11 (Mb)', ylabel='insulation (log2)', title='c  chr11, 30–40 Mb')
ax.legend(loc='lower left', ncols=2)
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['ins_n']` bins the largest difference is `{python} TEXT['ins_max']` (float32); the
same `{python} TEXT['ins_calls']` boundaries are called, `{python} TEXT['ins_only']` by one only, with
strengths within `{python} TEXT['ins_strength']`.

```{python}
record('Diamond insulation', 'mouse Hi-C, 10 kb, window 100 kb', f"cooltools {VERSIONS['cooltools']}",
       f"max |difference| {TEXT['ins_max']} over {TEXT['ins_n']} bins; the same {TEXT['ins_calls']} boundaries",
       'Identical (float32)', apps=['insulation'], refs=['cooltools-insulation'])
```

## 2 · Directionality index

Dixon et al. (2012): `sign(B − A)·(B − A)²/(A + B)`, A and B the contacts upstream and downstream within
the window. Reference: `domaincaller`'s `Chrom.calDI` on the balanced matrix, built as its own script
builds it.

| | chromosomix | domaincaller |
|---|---|---|
| window | `--window 40` (2 Mb) | `calDI(window=2_000_000)` |
| cells | every cell off the diagonal, `--ignoreDiags 0` | the upper triangle off the diagonal |
| coverage | `--minValid 0.5`: no score where either side holds under half its window | a score everywhere |

```{python}
DI = WORK / 'di'
MOUSE_50K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/50000'
mr('di', MOUSE_50K, '--window', 40, out=DI / 'app', name='di', analysis='Directionality index')
reference('domaincaller-di', 'Directionality index', 'domaincaller',
          [PYTHON, script('domaincaller_di'), MOUSE_50K, OUT], out=DI / 'domaincaller.npy')

clr50 = cooler.Cooler(f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/50000')
b_di = np.load(DI / 'domaincaller.npy')
a_di = table(one(DI / 'app', '*.di-w40.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float)
ok = np.isfinite(a_di) & np.isfinite(b_di)
relative = np.abs(a_di[ok] - b_di[ok]) / np.maximum(np.abs(b_di[ok]), np.median(np.abs(b_di[ok])))
di_only_ref = int((np.isfinite(b_di) & ~np.isfinite(a_di)).sum())
measures({
    'bins both score': f'{ok.sum():,}',
    'bins only domaincaller scores': f'{di_only_ref:,}',
    'bins only chromosomix scores': f'{int((np.isfinite(a_di) & ~np.isfinite(b_di)).sum()):,}',
    'relative difference, max': f'{relative.max():.1e}',
    'same sign': f'{(np.sign(a_di[ok]) == np.sign(b_di[ok])).mean():.2%}',
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-di
#| fig-cap: "Directionality index, 2 Mb window. a, every bin both score (symmetric-log axes); b, chr2, 40–70 Mb."
TEXT['di_max'] = f'{relative.max():.1e}'
TEXT['di_n'] = f'{ok.sum():,}'
TEXT['di_only_ref'] = f'{di_only_ref:,}'

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1, 1.6])
ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(b_di[ok], a_di[ok], s=3, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.35, lw=0, rasterized=True)
lim = np.abs(b_di[ok]).max()
identity(ax, -lim, lim)
TICKS = [-1, -0.1, -0.01, 0, 0.01, 0.1, 1]
ax.set_xscale('symlog', linthresh=0.01)
ax.set_yscale('symlog', linthresh=0.01)
ax.set_xticks(TICKS, [f'{t:g}' for t in TICKS])
ax.set_yticks(TICKS, [f'{t:g}' for t in TICKS])
ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(plt.NullLocator())
ax.yaxis.set_minor_locator(plt.NullLocator())
ax.set(xlabel='domaincaller', ylabel='chromosomix', title='a  every bin')
ax = axes[1]
lo, _ = clr50.extent('chr2')
stretch = slice(lo + 800, lo + 1_400)
x = clr50.bins()['start'][:].to_numpy()[stretch] / 1e6
ax.plot(x, b_di[stretch], color=REF, lw=3, label='domaincaller')
ax.plot(x, a_di[stretch], color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix')
ax.axhline(0, color=INK2, lw=0.8)
ax.set(xlabel='chr2 (Mb)', ylabel='directionality index', title='b  chr2, 40–70 Mb')
ax.legend(loc='lower left', ncols=2)
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['di_n']` bins the relative difference is at most `{python} TEXT['di_max']`
(float32), and every sign agrees. The `{python} TEXT['di_only_ref']` bins only domaincaller scores are

## 3 · Compartments

cooltools' preparation in both — observed/expected cis, clipped at its 99.9th percentile, less one —
and three eigenvectors ranked by eigenvalue and signed by GC content, computed once per 100 kb bin
(`bioframe.frac_gc`, mm10) and given to both. cooltools signs by Spearman correlation, the app by
Pearson, and the app leaves the sign unset below |r| = 0.1. chrY, mostly unmappable at 100 kb, is left
out of the comparison.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| components | `--components 3` | `n_eigs=3` |
| phasing | `--phaseTrack gc.bedGraph` | `phasing_track=gc` |
| diagonals left out; clipping | 2; 99.9th percentile (defaults) | `ignore_diags=2`; `clip_percentile=99.9` |

```{python}
CMP = WORK / 'compartments'
MOUSE_100K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/100000'
clr100 = cooler.Cooler(f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/100000')


def gc_content():
    import bioframe
    genome = bioframe.load_fasta(str(MM10), engine='pyfaidx')
    return bioframe.frac_gc(clr100.bins()[['chrom', 'start', 'end']][:], genome)


gc = cached(CMP / 'gc.tsv', gc_content)
GC_TRACK = CMP / 'gc.bedGraph'
if REDO or not GC_TRACK.exists():
    gc.dropna()[['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'GC']].to_csv(GC_TRACK, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
mr('compartments', MOUSE_100K, '--components', 3, '--phaseTrack', GC_TRACK, out=CMP / 'app',
   name='compartments', analysis='Compartments')
reference('cooltools-eigs', 'Compartments', 'cooltools',
          [PYTHON, script('cooltools_eigs_cis'), MOUSE_100K, CMP / 'gc.tsv', OUT],
          out=CMP / 'cooltools', made=CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvectors.tsv')

ref_vec = pd.read_csv(CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvectors.tsv', sep='\t')
ref_val = pd.read_csv(CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvalues.tsv', sep='\t')
app_vec = {k: table(one(CMP / 'app', f'*.compartment-e{k}.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float) for k in (1, 2, 3)}
app_comp = table(one(CMP / 'app', '*.compartment-components.tsv'))


def first(values):
    return values.iloc[0] if len(values) else np.nan


COMPARED = [chrom for chrom in clr100.chromnames if chrom != 'chrY']
rows = []
chrom100 = ref_vec['chrom'].astype(str).to_numpy()
for chrom in COMPARED:
    s = chrom100 == chrom
    row = {'chromosome': chrom}
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        row[f'r E{k}'] = pearson(app_vec[k][s], ref_vec[f'E{k}'].to_numpy(float)[s])
        eig_app = first(app_comp.loc[(app_comp['sequence'] == chrom) & (app_comp['component'] == f'E{k}'), 'eigenvalue'])
        eig_ref = first(ref_val.loc[ref_val['name'] == chrom, f'eigval{k}'])
        row[f'eigenvalue E{k}, relative difference'] = abs(eig_app / eig_ref - 1)
    e1a, e1b = app_vec[1][s], ref_vec['E1'].to_numpy(float)[s]
    ok = np.isfinite(e1a) & np.isfinite(e1b)
    row['A/B agreement'] = (np.sign(e1a[ok]) == np.sign(e1b[ok])).mean()
    phase = first(app_comp.loc[(app_comp['sequence'] == chrom) & (app_comp['component'] == 'E1'), 'r'])
    row['E1 against GC (app)'] = phase
    row['phasing'] = 'set' if abs(phase) >= 0.1 else 'ambiguous'
    rows.append(row)
cmp_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
show(cmp_table)
```

```{python}
TEXT['cmp_min_r'] = f"{phased['r E1'].min():.4f}"

                       f'the {len(phased)} chromosomes whose phasing is set ({ambiguous}: ambiguous, its E1 sign arbitrary)')

for k, colour, offset in ((1, APP_COLOUR, -0.2), (2, REF, 0), (3, '#1baf7a', 0.2)):
```

## 4 · P(s)

`--quantity expected --scope file`: per band of separations (factor 1.1), the balanced contacts of
every chromosome over the bin pairs that could hold them, at the band's pair-weighted mean separation.
cooltools' per-diagonal sums (`expected_cis`) are pooled over the same bands, each a run of consecutive
diagonals whose weighted mean is the separation the app writes.

```{python}
PS = WORK / 'ps'
YEAST_800 = f'{rel(YEAST)}::/resolutions/800'
PS_CASES = {'yeast Micro-C, 800 bp': ('yeast', YEAST_800, f'{YEAST}::/resolutions/800', 'yeast 800 bp'),
            'mouse Hi-C, 10 kb': ('mouse', MOUSE_10K, f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/10000', 'mouse 10 kb')}
EXPECTED = script('cooltools_expected_cis')


def bands(n_valid, separations, binsize):
    """The run of consecutive diagonals behind each separation the app wrote: from where the last
    ended, the longest run whose valid-pixel-weighted mean matches it to its six written digits."""
    k = np.arange(len(n_valid), dtype=float)
    cn = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(n_valid)])
    ck = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(n_valid * k)])
    runs, lo = [], 1
    for x in separations:
        tolerance = max(0.5, abs(x) * 5e-6)
        match = None
        for hi in range(lo + 1, len(n_valid) + 1):
            w = cn[hi] - cn[lo]
            if w <= 0:
                continue
            mean = (ck[hi] - ck[lo]) / w * binsize
            if abs(mean - x) <= tolerance:
                match = hi
            elif mean > x + tolerance:
                break
        if match is None:
            raise ValueError(f'no run of diagonals from {lo} has its mean at {x}')
        runs.append((lo, match))
        lo = match
    return runs


ps = {}
for label, (slug, uri, local, short) in PS_CASES.items():
    mr('expected', uri, '--quantity', 'expected', '--scope', 'file', out=PS / slug, name=f'expected-{slug}',
       analysis='P(s)', label=short)
    reference(f'cooltools-expected-{slug}', 'P(s)', 'cooltools', [PYTHON, EXPECTED, uri, OUT, THREADS],
              out=PS / f'{slug}-cooltools.tsv', label=short)
    app = table(one(PS / slug, '*.expected.ps.tsv'))
    cvd = pd.read_csv(PS / f'{slug}-cooltools.tsv', sep='\t')
    cvd['balanced.sum'] = cvd['balanced.sum'].fillna(0)
    ref = cvd.groupby('dist')[['n_valid', 'balanced.sum']].sum()
    n = ref['n_valid'].reindex(range(int(ref.index.max()) + 1), fill_value=0).to_numpy(float)
    total = ref['balanced.sum'].reindex(range(len(n)), fill_value=0).to_numpy(float)
    x, y = app.iloc[:, 0].to_numpy(float), app.iloc[:, 1].to_numpy(float)
    runs = bands(n, x, cooler.Cooler(local).binsize)
    pooled = np.array([total[a:b].sum() / n[a:b].sum() for a, b in runs])
    ps[label] = dict(x=x, app=y, ref=pooled, rel=np.abs(y / pooled - 1), reach=x.max())
show(pd.DataFrame([{'map': k, 'points': len(v['x']), 'furthest separation (Mb)': v['reach'] / 1e6,
                    'relative difference, max': v['rel'].max()} for k, v in ps.items()]),
     **{'furthest separation (Mb)': '{:.1f}', 'relative difference, max': '{:.1e}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ps
#| fig-cap: "P(s), chromosomix against cooltools.expected_cis pooled over the same bands. Top, the curves; bottom, the relative difference at every point."
TEXT['ps_max'] = f"{max(v['rel'].max() for v in ps.values()):.1e}"
TEXT['ps_points'] = f"{sum(len(v['x']) for v in ps.values())}"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 6.4), layout='constrained', height_ratios=[1.4, 1], sharex='col')
for col, (label, v) in enumerate(ps.items()):
    ax = axes[0, col]
    ax.plot(v['x'], v['ref'], color=REF, lw=3, label='cooltools, pooled')
    ax.scatter(v['x'], v['app'], s=14, color=APP_COLOUR, zorder=3, label='chromosomix')
    ax.set(xscale='log', yscale='log', ylabel='mean balanced contact per bin pair', title=label)
    ax.legend(loc='lower left')
    ax = axes[1, col]
    ax.scatter(v['x'], np.maximum(v['rel'], 1e-9), s=10, color=APP_COLOUR)
    ax.set(xscale='log', yscale='log', ylim=(1e-9, 1e-3), xlabel='separation (bp)',
           ylabel='|chromosomix / cooltools − 1|')
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['ps_points']` points, from one bin to the longest chromosome, the relative
difference is at most `{python} TEXT['ps_max']` (float32).

```{python}

       refs=['cooltools-expected-yeast', 'cooltools-expected-mouse'])
```

## 5 · Peak calling with IDR (yapc)

yapc (Jänes et al. 2018): the concave regions of the pooled signal's smoothed second derivative, scored
in each replicate and tested for reproducibility by IDR. Both tools are given the two replicates cut to
chr19, interval for interval (yapc holds a whole genome's second derivative in memory). Reference:
yapc 0.1's command line with IDR 2.0.3, NumPy's random seed fixed. yapc breaks score ties at random,
so it is run with five seeds, and their spread is the yardstick for IDR.

| | chromosomix | yapc 0.1 |
|---|---|---|
| smoothing | `--width 150 --times 3` | `--smoothing-window-width 150 --smoothing-times 3` |
| narrowest region | `--minWidth 75` | `--min-concave-region-width 75` |
| regions given to IDR | `--truncate 100000` | `--truncate-idr-input 100000` |
| IDR threshold | `--idr 0.05`, and a count at each of yapc's six | one BED at each of 0.001–0.2 |

```{python}
YP = WORK / 'yapc'
REPS = [DATA / f'{path.stem}.chr19.bw' for path in ATAC]


def chr19(source, target):
    """The track with chr19 only, interval for interval."""
    if target.exists() and not REDO:
        return
    handle = pyBigWig.open(str(source))
    out = pyBigWig.open(str(target), 'w')
    out.addHeader([('chr19', handle.chroms()['chr19'])])
    entries = handle.intervals('chr19') or ()
    out.addEntries(['chr19'] * len(entries), [int(a) for a, _, _ in entries],
                   ends=[int(b) for _, b, _ in entries], values=[float(v) for _, _, v in entries])
    out.close()
    handle.close()


for source, target in zip(ATAC, REPS):
    chr19(source, target)
mr('peaks', '--signal', REPS[0], '--replicate', REPS[1], '--perPeak', '--width', 150, '--times', 3,
   '--minWidth', 75, '--truncate', 100000, '--idr', 0.05, out=YP / 'app', name='peaks',
   analysis='Peak calling (yapc, IDR)')
YAPC_SCRIPT = script('yapc_idr')
SEEDS = {seed: YP / f'seed{seed}' for seed in range(5)}
for seed, folder in SEEDS.items():
    reference(f'yapc-seed{seed}', 'Peak calling (yapc, IDR)', 'yapc 0.1', [
        str(YAPC_PYTHON), YAPC_SCRIPT, seed, OUT, 'cond', *REPS, '--smoothing-window-width', 150,
        '--smoothing-times', 3, '--min-concave-region-width', 75, '--truncate-idr-input', 100000],
        out=folder / 'yapc', made=folder / 'yapc_0.05.bed', env=YAPC_ENV, label=f'seed {seed}', bench=seed == 0)

THRESHOLDS = [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]
peaksall = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[0] / 'yapc_peaksall.tsv', sep='\t')
ref_tested = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[0] / 'yapc.tsv', sep='\t')
listing = table(one(YP / 'app', '*.peaks-list.tsv')).rename(columns={'sequence': 'chrom'})
counts_app = table(one(YP / 'app', '*.peaks-idr.tsv'))
called_app = pd.read_csv(one(YP / 'app', '*.bed'), sep='\t', header=None, comment='#',
                         names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'name', 'score', 'strand'])
key = ['chrom', 'start', 'end']
bounds = ['chrom', 'concave_start', 'concave_end']
m = listing.merge(ref_tested.drop(columns=['start', 'end']), left_on=key, right_on=bounds, how='outer',
                  indicator=True)
shared = m[m['_merge'] == 'both']
curvature = np.abs(np.r_[shared['curvature0'] - shared['cond_rep1_score'],
                         shared['curvature1'] - shared['cond_rep2_score']])


def bed(th, seed=0):
    out = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[seed] / f'yapc_{th}.bed', sep='\t', header=None, comment='#').iloc[:, :3]
    out.columns = key
    return out


called_ref = bed(0.05)
same_called = called_app[key].merge(called_ref, on=key)
idr = called_app.merge(ref_tested, left_on=key, right_on=bounds)
# −log10 IDR over the peaks called: the app against each seed, and the seeds against one another.
runs = {seed: pd.read_csv(folder / 'yapc.tsv', sep='\t').set_index(bounds)['cond_globalIDR']
        for seed, folder in SEEDS.items()}
app_idr = called_app.set_index(key)['score'].rename_axis(bounds)
idr_app = [np.abs(runs[seed].reindex(app_idr.index) - app_idr).max() for seed in SEEDS]
idr_self = [np.abs(runs[a].reindex(app_idr.index) - runs[b].reindex(app_idr.index)).max()
            for a in SEEDS for b in SEEDS if a < b]
note = next(n for n in NOTES['peaks'] if 'concave region' in n)
found_app, wide_app = (int(re.search(rf'([\d,]+) {w}', note).group(1).replace(',', ''))
                       for w in ('concave region', 'at least'))
wide_ref = int(((peaksall['concave_end'] - peaksall['concave_start']) >= 75).sum())
measures({
    'concave regions, chromosomix / yapc': f'{found_app:,} / {len(peaksall):,}',
    'at least 75 bp, chromosomix / yapc': f'{wide_app:,} / {wide_ref:,}',
    'given to IDR, chromosomix / yapc': f'{len(listing):,} / {len(ref_tested):,}',
    'same bounds; in one only': f"{len(shared):,}; {int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}",
    'same summit': f"{(shared['summit'] == shared['mode']).mean():.2%}",
    'curvature, max |difference| (two decimals written)': f'{curvature.max():.4f}',
    'peaks at IDR ≤ 0.05, chromosomix / yapc; same': f'{len(called_app):,} / {len(called_ref):,}; {len(same_called):,}',
    '−log10 IDR of those peaks, max |difference| to each yapc seed': f'{min(idr_app):.1e} to {max(idr_app):.1e}',
    '−log10 IDR, yapc seeds against one another': f'{min(idr_self):.1e} to {max(idr_self):.1e}',
})
```

```{python}
def counted(th):
    values = sorted({len(bed(th, seed)) for seed in SEEDS})
    return f'{values[0]:,}' if len(values) == 1 else f'{values[0]:,}–{values[-1]:,}'


show(pd.DataFrame([{'IDR ≤': th, f'yapc 0.1, seeds 0–{len(SEEDS) - 1}': counted(th),
                    'chromosomix': f"{int(counts_app.loc[np.isclose(counts_app['threshold'], th), 'peaks'].iloc[0]):,}"}
                   for th in THRESHOLDS]), **{'IDR ≤': '{:g}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-yapc
#| fig-cap: "yapc with IDR on two mouse ATAC-seq replicates, chr19. a, the curvature of every region given to IDR, both replicates; b, −log10 IDR of every peak called at IDR ≤ 0.05."
TEXT['yapc_n'] = f'{len(shared):,}'
TEXT['yapc_curv'] = f'{curvature.max():.4f}'
TEXT['yapc_called'] = f'{len(same_called):,}'
TEXT['yapc_idr'] = f'{max(idr_app):.1e}'
TEXT['yapc_self'] = f'{max(idr_self):.1e}'
TEXT['yapc_counts'] = 'every one' if all(
    len(bed(th, seed)) == int(counts_app.loc[np.isclose(counts_app['threshold'], th), 'peaks'].iloc[0])
    for th in THRESHOLDS for seed in SEEDS) else 'not every one'
# Within the spread of yapc's own runs, the six significant digits the app's BED writes aside.
IDR_WITHIN = max(idr_app) <= max(idr_self) + 1e-5

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), layout='constrained')
agreement(axes[0], np.r_[shared['cond_rep1_score'], shared['cond_rep2_score']],
          np.r_[shared['curvature0'], shared['curvature1']], 'yapc 0.1', 'chromosomix', 'a  curvature')
agreement(axes[1], idr['cond_globalIDR'].to_numpy(float), idr['score'].to_numpy(float), 'yapc 0.1',
          'chromosomix', 'b  −log10 IDR, called peaks')
plt.show()
```

The same `{python} TEXT['yapc_n']` regions go to IDR, with the same summits and curvatures within the
two decimals written. `{python} TEXT['yapc_called']` peaks pass IDR ≤ 0.05 in both, the same regions;
their −log10 IDR is within `{python} TEXT['yapc_idr']` of every yapc run, whose five seeds differ from
one another by up to `{python} TEXT['yapc_self']`. The counts agree with every seed at
`{python} TEXT['yapc_counts']` of yapc's six thresholds.

```{python}
record('Peak calling (yapc, IDR)', 'mouse ATAC-seq, 2 replicates, chr19', f'yapc {YAPC}, idr {IDR}',
       f"{TEXT['yapc_n']} regions, same bounds and summits; {TEXT['yapc_called']} peaks at IDR ≤ 0.05; "
       f"−log10 IDR within {TEXT['yapc_idr']} of 5 yapc seeds (seeds among themselves: up to {TEXT['yapc_self']})",
       'Identical peaks' + ('; IDR within yapc\'s seed-to-seed spread' if IDR_WITHIN else ''),
       apps=['peaks'], refs=[f'yapc-seed{seed}' for seed in SEEDS])
```

## 6 · Loops (chromosight)

Chromosight's loop preset (`kernels/loops.json`) in both; calls matched by bin pair, p- and q-values
read from each call's detail.

```{python}
LP = WORK / 'loops'
mr('chromosight', YEAST_800, '--pattern', 'loops', out=LP / 'app', name='chromosight', analysis='Loops (chromosight)')
reference('chromosight', 'Loops (chromosight)', 'chromosight',
          [CHROMOSIGHT, 'detect', '--pattern', 'loops', '--threads', THREADS, YEAST_800, OUT],
          out=LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops', made=LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops.tsv')

ref_loops = pd.read_csv(LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops.tsv', sep='\t')
app_loops = table(one(LP / 'app', '*.chromosight-patterns.tsv'))
for key_ in ('p', 'q'):
    app_loops[key_] = app_loops['detail'].str.extract(rf'\b{key_} ([0-9.e+-]+)')[0].astype(float)
m = app_loops.merge(ref_loops, on=['chrom1', 'start1', 'chrom2', 'start2'], how='outer', indicator=True,
                    suffixes=('_app', '_ref'))
shared = m[m['_merge'] == 'both']
# chromosight writes p and q to ten decimals: compared where that leaves four significant digits.
readable = shared[shared['pvalue'] >= 1e-6]
readable_q = shared[shared['qvalue'] >= 1e-6]
measures({
    'loops, chromosomix / chromosight': f'{len(app_loops):,} / {len(ref_loops):,}',
    'same bin pair; in one only': f"{len(shared):,}; {int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}",
    'score, max |difference|': f"{np.abs(shared['score_app'] - shared['score_ref']).max():.1e}",
    f'p, max relative difference ({len(readable):,} loops with p ≥ 1e-6)':
        f"{np.abs(readable['p'] / readable['pvalue'] - 1).max():.1e}",
    f'q, max relative difference ({len(readable_q):,} loops with q ≥ 1e-6)':
        f"{np.abs(readable_q['q'] / readable_q['qvalue'] - 1).max():.1e}",
})
```

## 7 · Reproducibility (HiCRep)

The stratum-adjusted correlation (Yang et al. 2017) as `hicrep` 0.2.6 computes it: each map's upper
triangle, the main diagonal and every diagonal past the furthest compared set to zero, a 2D mean filter
of half-width `h`, a Pearson correlation per diagonal over the positions where either map has a contact,
and weights `(n + 1)/12`. Every pair of the three maps, on every chromosome longer than the furthest
diagonal compared.

| | chromosomix | hicrep |
|---|---|---|
| counts | raw, `--no-balance` | raw (`balance=False`) |
| smoothing | `--smooth 1` | `h=1` |
| furthest diagonal | `--maxDistance 50` (5 Mb) | `dBPMax=5_000_000` |
| depth | as read | `bDownSample=False` |

```{python}
HR = WORK / 'hicrep'
RES, STRATA = 100_000, 50
LABELS = [path.stem for path in CHICKEN]
URIS = {label: f'{rel(path)}::/resolutions/{RES}' for label, path in zip(LABELS, CHICKEN)}
SEQS = [c for c, length in cooler.Cooler(f'{CHICKEN[0]}::/resolutions/{RES}').chromsizes.items()
        if length >= (STRATA + 1) * RES]
PAIRS = f'{len(LABELS)} maps, {len(LABELS) * (len(LABELS) - 1) // 2} pairs'
against = [a for label in LABELS[1:] for a in ('--against', URIS[label])]
mr('hicrep', URIS[LABELS[0]], *against, '--maxDistance', STRATA, '--smooth', 1, '--no-balance',
   '--sequences', ','.join(SEQS), out=HR / 'app', name='hicrep', analysis='Reproducibility (HiCRep)', label=PAIRS)
reference('hicrep', 'Reproducibility (HiCRep)', 'hicrep',
          [PYTHON, script('hicrep_scc'), OUT, ','.join(SEQS), *[f'{label}={URIS[label]}' for label in LABELS]],
          out=HR / 'hicrep.tsv', label=PAIRS)

names = {'This map': LABELS[0], **{path.name: label for label, path in zip(LABELS, CHICKEN)}}
app_scc = table(one(HR / 'app', '*.hicrep-sequences.tsv'))
app_scc['a'], app_scc['b'] = app_scc['a'].map(names), app_scc['b'].map(names)


def unordered(frame):
    order = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(LABELS)}
    swap = frame['a'].map(order) > frame['b'].map(order)
    frame.loc[swap, ['a', 'b']] = frame.loc[swap, ['b', 'a']].to_numpy()
    return frame


scc = (unordered(app_scc[['a', 'b', 'sequence', 'scc']].rename(columns={'scc': 'chromosomix'}))
       .merge(unordered(pd.read_csv(HR / 'hicrep.tsv', sep='\t')), on=['a', 'b', 'sequence']))
scc_diff = scc['chromosomix'] - scc['hicrep']
measures({
    'values (pairs × chromosomes)': f'{len(scc):,}',
    'mean difference': f'{scc_diff.mean():+.1e}',
    'max |difference|': f'{scc_diff.abs().max():.1e}',
    'Pearson r': f"{pearson(scc['chromosomix'].to_numpy(), scc['hicrep'].to_numpy()):.6f}",
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-hicrep
#| fig-cap: "HiCRep on three chicken Hi-C maps at 100 kb, every pair, every chromosome of at least 5.1 Mb. a, chromosomix against hicrep; b, their difference, value by value."
TEXT['hr_n'] = f'{len(scc)}'
TEXT['hr_max'] = f'{scc_diff.abs().max():.1e}'

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2), layout='constrained')
ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(scc['hicrep'], scc['chromosomix'], s=10, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.6, lw=0)
identity(ax, 0, 1)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 1), ylim=(0, 1), xlabel='hicrep SCC', ylabel='chromosomix SCC', title='a  every value')
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax = axes[1]
ax.hist(scc_diff * 1e5, bins=np.linspace(-6, 6, 49), color=APP_COLOUR)
for edge in (-5, 5):
    ax.axvline(edge, color=INK2, lw=1, ls=(0, (4, 3)))
ax.set(xlabel='chromosomix − hicrep (×10⁻⁵)', ylabel='pairs × chromosomes',
       title='b  difference; dashed, the rounding of four decimals')
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['hr_n']` values the two differ by at most `{python} TEXT['hr_max']`, the rounding
of the four decimals the app writes an SCC to.

```{python}
       f"within {TEXT['hr_max']} over {TEXT['hr_n']} values (4 decimals written)",
       'Identical', apps=['hicrep'], refs=['hicrep'])
```

## 8 · 3D model (pastis-NB)

Counts drawn from a negative binomial of mean `β·bᵢ·bⱼ·d^−α`, α = 3, with `bᵢ = 1/wᵢ` from the file's
balancing weights and zeros taken as counts. Reference: pastis (GitHub `6888ac2`; Varoquaux, Noble &
Vert 2023) through its own functions — the dispersion fitted against the mean
(`ExponentialDispersion(degree=1)`), an MDS start, `negative_binomial_structure.estimate_X` — on the same
beads (bins with a weight and a contact). The app departs on purpose: its dispersion is a moment
estimate per separation, its start ShRec3D's MDS. A structure has no unique solution, so pastis from
three seeds is the yardstick. chromosomix runs its default 150 steps.

```{python}
P3 = WORK / 'pastis'
YEAST_12K = f'{rel(YEAST)}::/resolutions/12800'
mr('reconstruct3d', YEAST_12K, '--method', 'nb', '--alpha', 3, out=P3 / 'app', name='reconstruct3d',
   analysis='3D model (pastis-NB)', label='150 steps')
PASTIS = script('pastis_nb')
for seed in (0, 1, 2):
    reference(f'pastis-seed{seed}', '3D model (pastis-NB)', 'pastis', [PYTHON, PASTIS, YEAST_12K, OUT, seed],
              out=P3 / f'pastis-seed{seed}.npy', label=f'seed {seed}', bench=seed == 0)

clr_y = cooler.Cooler(f'{YEAST}::/resolutions/12800')
raw_y = clr_y.matrix(balance=False)[:].astype(float)
w_y = clr_y.bins()['weight'][:].to_numpy(float)
KEEP = np.isfinite(w_y) & (raw_y.sum(axis=0) > 0)
beads = clr_y.bins()[['chrom', 'start']][:][KEEP].reset_index(drop=True)
bead_chrom = beads['chrom'].astype(str).to_numpy()


def app_model(folder):
    bed3d = pd.read_csv(one(folder, '*.bed3d'), sep='\t', comment='#', header=None,
                        names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'x', 'y', 'z'])
    return beads.merge(bed3d, on=['chrom', 'start'], how='left')[['x', 'y', 'z']].to_numpy(float)


MODELS = {'chromosomix': app_model(P3 / 'app'),
          **{f'pastis, seed {s}': np.load(P3 / f'pastis-seed{s}.npy') for s in (0, 1, 2)}}
assert all(model.shape == (KEEP.sum(), 3) and np.isfinite(model).all() for model in MODELS.values()), \
    'a bead is missing from a model'
```

```{python}
from scipy.spatial import procrustes
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform

same = squareform(np.equal.outer(bead_chrom, bead_chrom).astype(int), checks=False).astype(bool)
dist = {name: pdist(model) for name, model in MODELS.items()}
contacts = squareform(raw_y[np.ix_(KEEP, KEEP)] * np.outer(w_y[KEEP], w_y[KEEP]), checks=False)
seen = contacts > 0


def per_chromosome_disparity(a, b):
    return np.median([procrustes(a[bead_chrom == c], b[bead_chrom == c])[2] for c in pd.unique(bead_chrom)])


rows = []
names_ = list(MODELS)
for i, a in enumerate(names_):
    for b in names_[i + 1:]:
        rows.append({'models': f'{a} / {b}',
                     'kind': 'pastis vs pastis' if a.startswith('pastis') else 'chromosomix vs pastis',
                     'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ': stats.spearmanr(dist[a][same], dist[b][same])[0],
                     'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ': stats.spearmanr(dist[a][~same], dist[b][~same])[0],
                     'per-chromosome Procrustes disparity': per_chromosome_disparity(MODELS[a], MODELS[b])})
models_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fit_table = pd.DataFrame([{'model': name, 'fit, all pairs': stats.spearmanr(1 / d[seen], contacts[seen])[0],
                           'fit, within chromosomes': stats.spearmanr(1 / d[seen & same], contacts[seen & same])[0]}
                          for name, d in dist.items()])
display(show(models_table, precision=3))
show(fit_table, precision=3)
```

The fit is the Spearman correlation of `1/d` with the balanced contacts over every pair of beads the
map counted.

```{python}
#| label: fig-pastis
#| fig-cap: "pastis-NB, yeast Micro-C at 12.8 kb. a, distances within chromosomes, chromosomix against pastis' first seed, each over its model's median distance between neighbouring beads; b, how alike two models are, within and between chromosomes."
cross = models_table[models_table['kind'] == 'chromosomix vs pastis']
selfs = models_table[models_table['kind'] == 'pastis vs pastis']


def spread(frame, column, digits):
    return f"{frame[column].min():.{digits}f}–{frame[column].max():.{digits}f}"


TEXT['p3_beads'] = f'{KEEP.sum():,}'
TEXT['p3_intra_cross'] = spread(cross, 'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 3)
TEXT['p3_intra_self'] = spread(selfs, 'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 3)
TEXT['p3_inter_cross'] = spread(cross, 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 2)
TEXT['p3_inter_self'] = spread(selfs, 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 2)
fits = fit_table.set_index('model')['fit, all pairs']
TEXT['p3_fit_app'] = f"{fits['chromosomix']:.3f}"
pastis_fits = fits[[n for n in fits.index if n.startswith('pastis')]]
TEXT['p3_fit_pastis'] = f"{pastis_fits.min():.3f}–{pastis_fits.max():.3f}"
within = fit_table.set_index('model')['fit, within chromosomes']
pastis_within = within[[n for n in within.index if n.startswith('pastis')]]
TEXT['p3_fit_app_within'] = f"{within['chromosomix']:.3f}"
TEXT['p3_fit_pastis_within'] = f"{pastis_within.min():.3f}–{pastis_within.max():.3f}"


def versus(app, reference_):
    return 'better than' if app > reference_.max() else 'less well than' if app < reference_.min() else 'as well as'


TEXT['p3_within_word'] = versus(within['chromosomix'], pastis_within)
TEXT['p3_all_word'] = versus(fits['chromosomix'], pastis_fits)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.6), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1, 1.15])


def scaled(model):
    step = np.median(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(model, axis=0), axis=1)[bead_chrom[1:] == bead_chrom[:-1]])
    return pdist(model) / step


agreement(axes[0], scaled(MODELS['pastis, seed 0'])[same], scaled(MODELS['chromosomix'])[same],
          'pastis, seed 0', 'chromosomix', 'a  distances within chromosomes', scale='log')
ax = axes[1]
for col, metric in enumerate(('within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ')):
    for offset, frame, colour, label in ((-0.12, cross, APP_COLOUR, 'chromosomix vs pastis'),
                                         (0.12, selfs, REF, 'pastis vs pastis')):
        ax.scatter(np.full(len(frame), col + offset), frame[metric], s=36, color=colour,
                   label=label if col == 0 else None, zorder=3)
ax.set_xticks([0, 1], ['within chromosomes', 'between chromosomes'])
ax.set(xlim=(-0.5, 1.5), ylim=(0, 1.02), ylabel='Spearman ρ of pairwise distances', title='b  how alike two runs are')
ax.legend(loc='lower left')
plt.show()
```

On `{python} TEXT['p3_beads']` beads, distances within chromosomes correlate with pastis' at
ρ = `{python} TEXT['p3_intra_cross']`, against `{python} TEXT['p3_intra_self']` between pastis seeds;
between chromosomes at `{python} TEXT['p3_inter_cross']` (`{python} TEXT['p3_inter_self']`).
chromosomix's model fits the contacts within chromosomes `{python} TEXT['p3_within_word']` pastis'
(`{python} TEXT['p3_fit_app_within']` against `{python} TEXT['p3_fit_pastis_within']`), and over all
pairs, the chromosomes' arrangement included, `{python} TEXT['p3_all_word']` pastis'
(`{python} TEXT['p3_fit_app']` against `{python} TEXT['p3_fit_pastis']`).

```{python}
record('3D model (pastis-NB)', f"yeast Micro-C, 12.8 kb, {TEXT['p3_beads']} beads", 'pastis 0.5.0 (GitHub 6888ac2)',
       f"within chromosomes ρ = {TEXT['p3_intra_cross']} (pastis vs pastis {TEXT['p3_intra_self']}); "
       f"fit within chromosomes {TEXT['p3_fit_app_within']} vs {TEXT['p3_fit_pastis_within']}, "
       f"all pairs {TEXT['p3_fit_app']} vs {TEXT['p3_fit_pastis']}",
```

## Time

Each command of the summary is run `{python} str(RUNS)` times as a fresh process, exactly as printed but
writing to a scratch folder, round robin. CPU time is counted: user and system, of the process and every
process it started. `chromosomix` computes on one thread; cooltools' insulation and P(s), and
chromosight, were given `{python} str(THREADS)` processes.

```{python}
BENCH = WORK / 'benchmark'
ANALYSES = [row['Analysis'] for row in SUMMARY]


def timed(argv, env=None):
    """CPU seconds of one command and every process it started, run from work/validation/."""
    before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    run = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORK, env=env)
    after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    if run.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{typed(argv)}\n{run.stderr[-3000:]}')
    return (after.ru_utime - before.ru_utime) + (after.ru_stime - before.ru_stime)


def jobs():
    """What is timed, in the summary's order: each analysis's chromosomix commands, then its references."""
    out = []
    for analysis in ANALYSES:
        for name, app in APP.items():
            if app['analysis'] == analysis and app['bench']:
                out.append(dict(name=name, analysis=analysis, tool='chromosomix', label=app['label'], env=None,
                                argv=lambda scratch, app=app: app['argv'] + ['--out', rel(scratch)]))
        for name, ref in REFS.items():
            if ref['analysis'] == analysis and ref['bench']:
                out.append(dict(name=name, analysis=analysis, tool=ref['tool'], label=ref['label'], env=ref['env'],
                                argv=lambda scratch, ref=ref: [rel(scratch / ref['out'].name) if a == OUT else a
                                                               for a in ref['argv']]))
    return out


def machine():
    cpu = platform.processor()
    if Path('/proc/cpuinfo').exists():
        cpu = next((line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in open('/proc/cpuinfo') if line.startswith('model name')), cpu)
    try:
        memory = f"{os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE') * os.sysconf('SC_PHYS_PAGES') / 1e9:.0f} GB"
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        memory = '?'
    node = subprocess.run(['node', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return {'processor': cpu, 'cores': str(os.cpu_count()), 'memory': memory, 'system': platform.platform(),
            'Node': node, 'Python': platform.python_version(), 'measured': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}


def benchmark():
    order, rows = jobs(), []
    for run in range(1, RUNS + 1):
        for i, job in enumerate(order):
            scratch = BENCH / 'scratch' / job['name']
            shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)
            scratch.mkdir(parents=True)
            cpu = timed(job['argv'](scratch), job['env'])
            shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)
            rows.append({'order': i, 'analysis': job['analysis'], 'tool': job['tool'], 'variant': job['label'],
                         'run': run, 'CPU s': cpu})
    (BENCH / 'machine.json').write_text(json.dumps(machine(), indent=1))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


if REDO_BENCHMARK or not (BENCH / 'times.tsv').exists():
    BENCH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    benchmark().to_csv(BENCH / 'times.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
times = pd.read_csv(BENCH / 'times.tsv', sep='\t', keep_default_na=False)
measures(json.loads((BENCH / 'machine.json').read_text()))
```

```{python}
#| column: page
key = ['order', 'analysis', 'tool', 'variant']
wide = times.pivot_table(index=key, columns='run', values='CPU s').reset_index()
wide.columns = [f'run {c}' if isinstance(c, (int, np.integer)) else c for c in wide.columns]
stats_ = times.groupby(key).agg(mean=('CPU s', 'mean'), sd=('CPU s', 'std')).reset_index()
wide = wide.merge(stats_, on=key).sort_values('order').reset_index(drop=True)
wide['CPU, mean ± sd'] = [f'{m:.2f} ± {s:.2f}' for m, s in zip(wide['mean'], wide['sd'])]


def against_reference(row):
    """A chromosomix row's reference: the same analysis and variant, or the analysis's one reference."""
    refs = wide[(wide['analysis'] == row['analysis']) & (wide['tool'] != 'chromosomix')]
    same = refs[refs['variant'] == row['variant']]
    pick = same if len(same) == 1 else refs if len(refs) == 1 else None
    return np.nan if pick is None else pick['mean'].iloc[0] / row['mean']


wide['fold'] = [against_reference(row) if row['tool'] == 'chromosomix' else np.nan for _, row in wide.iterrows()]
wide['× faster than the reference'] = [f'{f:.1f}×' if np.isfinite(f) else '' for f in wide['fold']]
run_columns = [f'run {r}' for r in range(1, RUNS + 1)]
show(wide[['analysis', 'tool', 'variant', *run_columns, 'CPU, mean ± sd', '× faster than the reference']], precision=2)
```

```{python}
folds = wide['fold'].dropna()
TEXT['t_fold'] = f'{folds.mean():.1f}'
TEXT['t_n'] = f'{len(folds)}'
TEXT['t_range'] = f'{folds.min():.1f}× to {folds.max():.1f}×'
TEXT['t_sd'] = f"{(wide['sd'] / wide['mean']).max():.0%}"
```

CPU seconds per run, and the mean ± sd. On average overall, `chromosomix` is
**`{python} TEXT['t_fold']`-fold faster** than the reference tools: the mean of the
`{python} TEXT['t_n']` folds in the last column (`{python} TEXT['t_range']`). No command's time spreads
by more than `{python} TEXT['t_sd']` of its mean across runs.

```{python}
#| label: fig-time
#| fig-cap: "CPU time of every timed command, each run a dot and the mean a bar, on a logarithmic axis; the rows of one analysis share a band."
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter, NullLocator

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 0.36 * len(wide) + 1.2), layout='constrained')
y = np.arange(len(wide))[::-1]
for k, (analysis, members) in enumerate(wide.groupby('analysis', sort=False)):
    if k % 2:
        ax.axhspan(y[members.index].min() - 0.5, y[members.index].max() + 0.5, color=MISSING, lw=0, zorder=0)
for yi, (_, row) in zip(y, wide.iterrows()):
    colour = APP_COLOUR if row['tool'] == 'chromosomix' else REF
    runs_ = times[times['order'] == row['order']]['CPU s']
    ax.scatter(runs_, np.full(len(runs_), yi), s=14, color=colour, alpha=0.55, lw=0, zorder=3)
    ax.plot([row['mean']] * 2, [yi - 0.3, yi + 0.3], color=colour, lw=2.5, zorder=4)
labels = [f"{row['analysis']} · {row['tool']}" + (f" ({row['variant']})" if row['variant'] else '')
          for _, row in wide.iterrows()]
ax.set_yticks(y, labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlim(times['CPU s'].min() / 1.5, times['CPU s'].max() * 1.5)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:g}'))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
ax.set(xlabel='CPU time (s)', ylim=(-0.5, len(wide) - 0.5))
ax.grid(axis='y', visible=False)
ax.scatter([], [], s=24, color=APP_COLOUR, label='chromosomix')
ax.scatter([], [], s=24, color=REF, label='reference')
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
plt.show()
```
